g.text: 4h and 1d are exploratory. 1d OOS has 5 paired rows; Ridge B and A MSEs are both about 1.9 × 10²².

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #405065

g.text: The small 1d relative A–B gap is not stable evidence. This chart compares model errors, not trading profitability.
